summary: Toggle line comment doesn't work for multiple lines in CSS
description:
Type: Bug Toggle line comment in CSS creates a single comment block when multiple lines are selected. This creates an issue, aka corrupts the code, if the selected lines already contain comment(s). Highlight 2 lines: ```css /* flex-grow: 1; */ /* justify-self: center; */ ``` Press CTRL + / The result is currupted CSS: ```css flex-grow: 1; */ /* justify-self: center; ``` A possible fix is to process each line individually like it does in javascript.
